title: Collared structure
description: A normalized description of a collared equity structure as it stands on its as-of date. Describes today only: nothing forward-looking belongs here. Forward assumptions live in a scenario document (invariant 4, D-06). No field is required to identify a real product; `subject` and `advertised` are optional, user-asserted, and never enter a computation (D-02).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema. Well-formedness only is checked here; compatibility is enforced by the reader so it can emit a useful message (invariant 5, D-21). Below 1.0 the MINOR component is the compatibility axis: a 0.2.x reader refuses 0.3.x.

as_of.description: The date the position was true. Every report carries it in the header.

label.description: Free text for the user's own benefit. Never used in computation.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Reporting only; the engine is single-currency and does no conversion.

reference_id.description: Key into `underlyings` naming the index the structure is collared against. Every attachment and reference move is quoted against this underlying's level.

underlyings.description: Keyed dictionary; legs point at entries by key (D-07). Making this a dictionary rather than a field on each leg turns proxy-versus-reference basis into a declared fact rather than an accident.

held_asset.description: Required. A structure with no held asset is encoded as `weight: 0` with `kind: "none"`, not by omitting this object.

net_assets.description: NAV. Every notional in the report is divided by this.

cash_weight.description: Cash as a fraction of NAV. Enters the weights reconciliation identity.

expense_ratio.description: Annual, as a fraction. Pro-rated in the gradual-decline path.

risk_free_rate.description: Continuous rate used for discounting and for implied-vol inversion. Defaults to 0.04 when absent, matching the oracle.

day_count.description: Time is act/365 from as_of to expiry. A leg expiring today has T = 0 and is worth its intrinsic value.

subject.description: What the user asserts this document describes. Optional, user-supplied, and never read by any computation. The engine is blind (D-02).

advertised.description: What a fact sheet claims, recorded so the report can set it beside the computed figure. A claim about the document's subject, not an input to arithmetic.

level.description: Spot level in this underlying's own units. Strikes on legs pointing here are quoted in the same units.

level_source.description: Where the level came from. `solved_from_options` is gated by a residual diagnostic (spec section 10): above 5 index points the report requires a user-supplied level instead.

ratio_to_reference.description: Multiply a reference level by this to get this underlying's level. A tenth-scale proxy ETF is 0.1. Never compare a strike to the reference level without passing through it (spec section 0).

dividend_yield.description: Continuous yield q, used in Black-Scholes and in delta.

tracking_error_bps_annual.description: Reporting only. Surfaces proxy basis; enters no computation in v1.

kind.description: A hint that feeds classification alongside the constituent count. Architecture is derived, never trusted from this field alone.

weight.description: w_eq, the held asset as a fraction of NAV. Zero means there is no held asset, which blocks Lambda, concentration and active share (spec section 10).

response.description: The held asset's response to the reference. Explicit object, never an implicit 1.0 (invariant 2, D-08). This is the assumption the headline result turns on.

constituents.description: Name, weight and sector only (D-11). Sufficient for concentration and a sector view; resist adding fields until a computation demands one.

beta_down.description: Held-asset move per unit of reference move when the reference falls. The floor is flat if and only if this equals Lambda.

beta_up.description: The same when the reference rises. Above the cap the sign of the residual term flips, so a high-beta held asset adds to return in a rally.

source.description: Beta is an input, never an estimate (D-09). There is no `estimated` value here by design.

idio_vol_annual.description: Reporting only; enters no v1 computation.

underlying_id.description: Key into `underlyings`. The reader rejects a leg naming an underlying that is not present.

position.description: Direction lives here and only here. Never a sign on `contracts` (spec section 0).

strike.description: Quoted in its own underlying's units, not the reference's.

contracts.description: Always positive. A leg's units is contracts times multiplier.

mark_per_unit.description: Price per unit. Absent on any leg, the weights reconciliation is not computable and returns null with a stated blocker rather than 0.0 (invariant 3, D-16).

implied_vol.description: Used directly when present. Otherwise inverted from `mark_per_unit` by bisection; where neither is present the scenario's fallback_iv is used and the leg is recorded as modelled rather than marked.

role.description: A user or adapter hint for display. Classification is derived from the legs themselves and never trusts this field (spec section 2).
